thread:
Sara (support): forwarding ticket #12345 from Acme — they started getting tool/function-calling 400s after we enabled OpenAI compatibility on their Dedicated instance. says: 'tool selection failed, invalid tools field'. pasting sanitized request/response and our logs below.

Sara (support): Customer request they sent (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Calculate 2+2"}],
  "tools": [
    {
      "name": "calc",
      "description": "simple calculator",
      "parameters": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": { "expr": { "type": "string" } },
        "required": ["expr"]
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Sara (support): Our edge response (sanitized):
```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": 400,
    "message": "invalid_request: 'tools' must be an array of tool defs"
  },
  "correlation_id": "c-9f2a1b"
}
```

Sara (support): Relevant runtime log line: `2026-03-15T13:14:22Z runtimes/normalizer.go:241 warn found tools type object; compat-normalizer collapsed single-entry array into object` — looks like we collapsed it into object somewhere.

Evan (support): thanks. do we have the actual HTTP payload as the server received it (wire) + headers? content-type? And which compat flag they flipped?

Sara (support): Received headers: `content-type: application/json`, `x-redwood-instance: ded-acme-01`, `x-request-id: c-9f2a1b`. Wire payload we see in ingress proxy (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "messages": [...],
  "tools": {
    "name": "calc",
    "description": "simple calculator",
    "parameters": { "type": "object" }
  }
}
```

Sara (support): note: customer claims they sent an array. so the array became an object between ingress and the normalizer.

Maria (eng): that log matches a regression I introduced in the compat-normalizer patch — I added a fast path that tries to deref single-item arrays but messed up for incoming requests (it mutates the parsed AST). If ingress does any streaming repairs it might cause this.

Cheng (eng-ml): quick check: which component is responsible for the `tools` canonicalization? I thought it was parser -> compat-normalizer -> tool_router. If an array becomes an object we will later treat it as a schema mismatch when mapping against OpenAI-style tool defs.

Maria (eng): yes — parser yields json AST, compat-normalizer runs and currently does `if len(arr)==1 then return arr[0]` to allow "single-tool shorthand". That logic should only run on responses we send back to older clients, not on incoming requests. I'll revert the change or gate it behind a req-direction check.

Evan (support): customer is blocked — Dedicated customer, P1. they say this is breaking production flows and affecting billing. please priority.

Sara (support): provided customer workaround: re-send tools as an array with a dummy second tool (quick hack) OR route them through our legacy compatibility endpoint `/v1/oa/compat` (they asked if that exists). they refused the dummy hack; asked for ETA.

Maria (eng): created RINF-5234, assigned to eng-runtime. reproduction steps: posted unit test that sends the exact payload above to the ingress component and asserts server sees an array. failing now. ETA for rollback/hotfix: ~4-6h, will roll small patch to Dedicated staging first.

Cheng (eng-ml): can we add an extra safety check before normalization: if incoming json raw token for "tools" is `[` then skip the single-item collapse. simple guard, low risk.

Maria (eng): yep that's the plan. I'll push small change + test. will also add a follow-up to validate the outbound mapping so downstream tool_router can't choke.

Evan (support): I'll update Acme: explain issue, give correlation id c-9f2a1b, ETA ~6h, offer service credit and a staging patch if they want to test earlier.

Sara (support): ack — I'll notify customer and keep this thread updated. tagging ops-bot for deploy watch when patch is ready.

deploy-bot: scheduled rolling patch for `compat-normalizer` on `dedicated-staging-2` at 2026-03-15T18:30:00Z (watch window enabled).

Maria (eng): after patch I'll run the new unit and an integration test simulating single-item arrays + protobuf streaming. will push PR with changelog note.

Sara (support): thanks all — marking as escalated and will close when fix is verified in staging and customer confirms.
